title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure their health and the development of their baby. In this article, we will introduce international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are good for pregnancy:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which helps support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which helps support the development of the baby's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in iron, which helps support the production of red blood cells and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which help support the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, which helps support the development of the baby's muscles and tissues.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which help support the immune system and reduce the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a balanced plate for pregnancy, expectant mothers can combine these international pantry staples with other foods. For example:
- Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: a salad with leafy greens, lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: a soup with leafy greens, lentils, and chicken.

## Food Safety During Pregnancy
Expectant mothers need to be aware of food safety during pregnancy. The following foods should be avoided:
- Raw or undercooked foods.
- Foods high in mercury.
- Foods that contain listeria.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure their health and the development of their baby. International pantry staples that are good for pregnancy include oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus. Expectant mothers can combine these foods with other foods to build a balanced plate for pregnancy. For more information on [pregnancy meal planning](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner), expectant mothers can visit our website.

## Note
Expectant mothers should consult their doctor before making any changes to their diet. For more information on [prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition), expectant mothers can visit our website.
